description: Yard: the owner's yard. v = fxOps.yard(state) (store.view('yard') with what Fusion does for each move): to ship, out (where each unit is), to collect (off hire), to inspect, in repair, and the fleet of the persona's BUs with certificates by country and open customs; set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh. Ship, Collect, Inspect and Repaired open a confirmation first (askChain: fxOps.ask, a dry run of the engine that shows the transfer order or the asset's location update and its accounting); Confirm runs it through actChain (fxPage.act), and a failure stays in the dialog and on the page. Every list exports.

askDef.description: The confirmation open (fxOps.ask().def): its words and fields; kept while the fields are typed in.

form.description: The values typed in the confirmation's fields.

ask.description: fxOps.ask().preview: what EquipRite does, the money, what Fusion would do, who is told; the action and its payload.

askError.description: Why the last Confirm did not go through, in the engine's words (stays in the dialog).

failure.description: The last action that did not go through, kept on the page until dismissed or until an action works.

exportOpen.description: The list whose export menu is open.

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
